The new holder took the killed pod's expired lease, yet it defers that attempt as another pod's live one ('listener delivery deferred to another pod's attempt') for the 35 s attempt window. TestTwoPodsSIGKILLHandsOverInOrderWithin15s leaves the in-flight message out of what it checks. [inference] Fix: an attempt by the boot named in the expired lease record the new holder took is taken over at once; the settle batch then sorts it by stream sequence.
